question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Satiate
(CHSL 2021 Tier I)
options: Satisfy
Saturate
State
Starve
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Satisfy

Satiate - Satisfy

Explanation:
"Satiate" means to satisfy fully or to the point of excess. "Satisfy" is the most appropriate synonym as it conveys the idea of fulfilling a need or desire completely.
("Satiate" का अर्थ है पूरी तरह से संतुष्ट करना या अति तृप्त करना। "Satisfy" सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी है क्योंकि यह किसी आवश्यकता या इच्छा को पूरी तरह पूरा करने का भाव देता है।)

Other synonyms Words:
Gratify, Quench, Fill, Glut, Sate

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Satiate – तृप्त करना – To satisfy fully or to excess.
Example: "The lavish feast satiated everyone’s hunger."

Saturate – भिगोना/संतृप्त करना – To soak or fill completely.
Example: "The heavy rain saturated the soil."

State – अवस्था/कहना – A condition or mode of being; to express something clearly.
Example: "He stated his opinion clearly in the meeting."

Starve – भूखा रहना – To suffer or die from lack of food.
Example: "Many animals starve during harsh winters."

Satisfy – संतुष्ट करना – To fulfill a need or desire.
Example: "A good meal will satisfy your hunger."

Conclusion:
"Satisfy" is the best synonym for "satiate" because both words mean fulfilling a need or desire completely, whereas the other options do not convey the same meaning.
("Satisfy" शब्द "satiate" का सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी है क्योंकि दोनों शब्द किसी आवश्यकता या इच्छा को पूरी तरह पूरा करने का भाव देते हैं, जबकि अन्य विकल्प इस अर्थ को नहीं दर्शाते।)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.
Visiting a book fair always fills my heart with a great satisfaction.
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2022)
options: contentment
pride
refreshment
bliss
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: contentment

Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence. Visiting a book fair always fills my heart with a great satisfaction. - contentment

Explanation:
"Satisfaction" refers to a feeling of fulfillment or happiness derived from an experience. "Contentment" is the closest synonym, as it also means a state of peaceful happiness.
संतुष्टि का अर्थ है किसी अनुभव से प्राप्त पूर्णता या खुशी की भावना। "Contentment" इसका सबसे निकटतम समानार्थी है, क्योंकि यह भी शांतिपूर्ण खुशी की स्थिति को दर्शाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
fulfillment, gratification, pleasure, happiness, joy

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

satisfaction – संतुष्टि – A feeling of happiness or fulfillment.
Example: "Completing the project on time gave her immense satisfaction."

pride – गर्व – A feeling of deep pleasure derived from one's own achievements.
Example: "He felt great pride after winning the competition."

refreshment – ताज़गी – A feeling of being reinvigorated or energized.
Example: "A cold drink provided much-needed refreshment on a hot day."

bliss – परमानंद – Extreme happiness or joy.
Example: "The newlyweds were in a state of bliss."

contentment – संतोष – A state of happiness and satisfaction.
Example: "After a simple meal, he sat back in contentment."

Conclusion:
"Contentment" is the best synonym for "satisfaction" because both words describe a state of peaceful happiness and fulfillment, making them interchangeable in this context.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Saucy
(CGLE 2021 Tier I)
options: Cheeky
Tasty
Polite
Smooth
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Cheeky

Saucy - Cheeky

Explanation:
"Saucy" means being boldly disrespectful or impudent, which aligns closely with "cheeky," meaning irreverent or boldly rude.
"Saucy" का अर्थ है धृष्ट या अक्खड़, जो "cheeky" (बेधड़क या उद्दंड) के समान है।

Other synonyms Words:
Impudent, Brash, Bold, Impertinent, Audacious

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Saucy – धृष्ट / अक्खड़ – Showing boldness or lack of respect.
Example: "She gave a saucy reply to her teacher."

Tasty – स्वादिष्ट – Having a pleasant flavor.
Example: "The pasta was very tasty."

Polite – विनम्र – Showing good manners or courtesy.
Example: "He was always polite to his elders."

Smooth – चिकना / मुलायम – Having an even surface without roughness.
Example: "The table had a smooth finish."

Cheeky – बेधड़क / उद्दंड – Being boldly disrespectful in a playful way.
Example: "The child gave a cheeky grin when caught lying."

Conclusion:
"Cheeky" is the best synonym for "saucy" as both imply boldness and a lack of respect, often in a playful manner. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Savor
(Workshop Attendant)
options: dreamy
uncaring
blandness
relish
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: relish

[Word] - relish

Explanation:
The word "savor" means to enjoy or appreciate something fully, especially food or an experience. "Relish" is a perfect synonym as it also means to enjoy or take pleasure in something.
स्वाद लेना का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ का पूरी तरह से आनंद लेना, खासकर भोजन या अनुभव का। "Relish" एक सटीक समानार्थी शब्द है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी किसी चीज़ का आनंद लेना है।

Other synonyms Words:
enjoy, appreciate, delight in, bask in, cherish

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

savor – आनंद लेना – To enjoy or appreciate something fully.
Example: "She took a moment to savor the delicious dessert."

dreamy – स्वप्निल – Having a magical or pleasantly unreal quality.
Example: "He had a dreamy expression while listening to music."

uncaring – बेपरवाह – Not showing sympathy or concern for others.
Example: "His uncaring attitude hurt her feelings."

blandness – नीरसता – Lack of strong flavor or excitement.
Example: "The blandness of the soup disappointed the guests."

relish – आनंद लेना – To enjoy or take great pleasure in something.
Example: "He relished every bite of the spicy dish."

Conclusion:
"Relish" is the best synonym for "savor" because both words convey the idea of enjoying something deeply. The other options do not match this meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
The investment scheme had been a scam all along.
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2023)
options: Plain
Successful
Failure
Swindle
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Swindle

scam - Swindle

Explanation:
The word "scam" refers to a dishonest scheme or fraud, and "swindle" means to cheat someone out of money or property through deception. Both words convey the idea of fraudulent behavior.
हिंदी अर्थ: "Scam" का अर्थ है धोखाधड़ी या छल, और "swindle" का अर्थ धोखे से पैसे या संपत्ति हड़पना है। दोनों शब्द बेईमानी के विचार को व्यक्त करते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
fraud, deception, hoax, trickery, racket

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

scam – धोखाधड़ी – (a dishonest scheme or fraud)
Example: "The investment scheme had been a scam all along."

Plain – सादा – (simple, not elaborate)
Example: "She wore a plain white dress to the party."

Successful – सफल – (achieving desired results)
Example: "His business became highly successful within a year."

Failure – असफलता – (lack of success)
Example: "The project ended in failure due to poor planning."

Swindle – ठगी – (to cheat someone out of money or property)
Example: "He was arrested for trying to swindle elderly people."

Conclusion:
"Swindle" is the best synonym for "scam" because both involve deceitful actions for financial gain. The other options (plain, successful, failure) do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of ‘scanty’ in the sentence given below.India has varied regions which have excess, moderate and deficient rainfall all through the year.
(MTS Non Tech Havaldar CBIC and CBN Examination 2024 )
options: Deficient
Moderate
Varied
Excess
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Deficient

scanty - Deficient

Explanation:
The word "scanty" means insufficient or not enough, which aligns with "deficient" meaning lacking in quantity or inadequate.
"scanty" का अर्थ है अपर्याप्त या कम, जो "deficient" (कमी या अपर्याप्तता) के अर्थ से मेल खाता है।

Other synonyms Words:
meager, sparse, limited, inadequate, insufficient

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

scanty – अपर्याप्त – (very little in quantity)
Example: "The villagers faced water shortages due to scanty rainfall."

Moderate – मध्यम – (average in amount or intensity)
Example: "The region receives moderate rainfall during the monsoon."

Varied – विविध – (diverse or different in kind)
Example: "India has varied climatic conditions across its regions."

Excess – अत्यधिक – (more than necessary)
Example: "Excess rainfall often leads to floods in coastal areas."

Deficient – कमी – (lacking in some necessary quality)
Example: "Crops failed due to deficient rainfall this year."

Conclusion:
"Deficient" is the best synonym for "scanty" as both imply insufficiency or lack, making it the most appropriate choice in the given context.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Scared
(Constable GD Examination 2022)
options: Confident
Calm
Reassured
Frightened
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Frightened

Scared - Frightened

Explanation:
"Frightened" is the correct synonym for "scared" because both words describe a state of fear or alarm.
डरा हुआ (Scared) और भयभीत (Frightened) दोनों ही डर या चिंता की स्थिति को दर्शाते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
Afraid, Terrified, Panicked, Alarmed, Apprehensive

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Scared – डरा हुआ – (Feeling fear or anxiety)
Example: "She was scared of the dark."

Confident – आत्मविश्वासी – (Feeling sure of oneself)
Example: "He was confident about his presentation."

Calm – शांत – (Peaceful and free from agitation)
Example: "She remained calm during the crisis."

Reassured – आश्वस्त – (Having doubts or fears removed)
Example: "The doctor reassured the patient about the procedure."

Frightened – भयभीत – (Afraid or anxious)
Example: "The loud noise frightened the child."

Conclusion:
"Frightened" is the best synonym for "scared" as both convey the same emotion of fear, whereas the other options (confident, calm, reassured) express opposite or unrelated feelings.
"Frightened" और "scared" दोनों डर की भावना को व्यक्त करते हैं, जबकि अन्य विकल्प (confident, calm, reassured) विपरीत या असंबंधित भावनाएं दर्शाते हैं।

Among the given options, "sneer" is the best synonym for "scoff" as both words express a mocking or contemptuous attitude. The other options—flatter, approve, and trust—have entirely different meanings and do not convey scorn or ridicule.
